svg.aria-label: Running relative frequency of an overfull session (all 11 booked patients turn up) against the number of trials, on a log scale from 1 to 10,000. The 20 hand trials end at 0.40. Five runs of 10,000 trials from a random number generator wander widely before 100 trials and all end between 0.31 and 0.33, close to the long-run value 0.314.
svg.text: number of trials (clinic sessions), log scale
